translation: Since it can be rubbed away, then all that the heart loses its constancy in is nothing but disease, and there is nothing that cannot be rubbed and restored. The whites of my eyes formerly had many red threads; after rubbing they all disappeared. Reasoning from this, if the heart has a nebula, it should also be able to recede; when the effort arrives, there will certainly be evidence, but now I dare not be certain, and later it also cannot be predicted.
